def check_integer(text):
    """Write a function to check if a string represents an integer or not."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        return False
    stripped = text.strip()
    if not stripped:
        return False
    if stripped[0] in "+-":
        stripped = stripped[1:]
    return stripped.isdecimal()
